## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Vipassībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 21) is the twenty-first chapter of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, located in the late sutta section of the Pali canon, recounting the biographical lineage and dispensation of the past Buddha Vipassī [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral]. No direct discussions of this text were identified in the surveyed secondary literature passages.

According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits significant textual reuse within the Pali tradition, sharing 448 matching segments across 31 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest and most extensive overlap occurs with its commentary, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* (138 matches, including a shared sequence at §10.1–20.6) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, because of the standardized structural framework of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, the text shares extensive parallel passages and formulaic descriptions with biographical accounts of other past Buddhas, including the *Kassapabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 26), *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 4), and *Sikhībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 22), as well as related narrative sections in the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Thūpavaṁsa* [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali literature, automated alignments generated by DharmaNexus indicate textual affinities with Tibetan translations of narrative texts such as the *Jātakanidāna* (D0032) and Haribhaṭṭa's Sanskrit *Jātakamālā* [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
